subject.title: feat(config): add compaction.thinkingLevel to override thinking level during compaction

question: Should OpenClaw accept a narrow `agents.defaults.compaction.thinkingLevel` public config key now, or defer compaction thinking control into a broader compaction override design?
rationale: The patch adds a public config knob in a compatibility-sensitive area, and the correct permanent scope cannot be decided from the code diff alone.

options.title: Repair and keep the narrow key
options.body: Wire the key through all supported non-Codex compaction paths, keep Codex-native behavior explicitly ignored, and require redacted proof before merge.

options.title: Fold into broader override work
options.body: Pause this PR and carry the thinking-level behavior into a broader per-agent compaction configuration design.

options.title: Decline the config surface
options.body: Keep compaction tied to the session thinking level until maintainers accept a stronger product case for another compaction knob.

recommendation.title: Repair and keep the narrow key
recommendation.body: Wire the key through all supported non-Codex compaction paths, keep Codex-native behavior explicitly ignored, and require redacted proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: jalehman is the current assignee and has recent adjacent session/compaction boundary history.
